Esther Francisco died 1810 Kent Co., DE Probate Records

Administration Bond granted August 20, 1810 {excerpt: Administration on the above estate was granted to Jacob Stout } Inventory of Esther Francisco, 1810 An Inventory of Goods and Chattels Rights and Credits of Esther Fransisco free woman of colour late of Little Creek Hundred Kent County in the state of Delaware deceased as shown to us by Jacob Stout her administrator and appraised the 3 day of 12th month 1810 - to whit- : To her wearing apperral 45.-- To a bedstead bed and beding 40.-- To suit of Curtens table cloth and 3 towels 3.-- To 2 old Chests and 1 trunk 1 old Looking Glass 2.50 To a Lot of books/hooks(?) 3 spoons and a small bunch of cotton 1.65 To 1 old walnut table and a small pine one 2.-- To 1 Lage arm Chair and 2 of smaller ones & frying pan 2.40 96.55 State of Delaware Kent County Personally appeared Jonathan Alston and John Cowgill before me the subscriber one of the Justices of the Peace in and for said County and upon solemn affirmations declared that the above and foregoing Inventory of appraisement or valuation of the effects of Esther Fransisco is a Conscionable(?) one. August 12th, 1811 (signed) Wm. Ruth Adm. Account - Esther Francisco - 13th August 1811 To James Harper Register, Jacob Stout Admn. of Esther Francisco dec'd renders the following acct. of his administration of said deceaseds Estate & craves its adjustments. THE DECEASEDS ESTATE D 1810 Aug. 20 To Letters of Admin. 2.17 To appraisers fees 1.93 To expenses digging Grave 1.50 1811 May 11 To Cash od Wm. Knotts as per Probt. 2.03 July 6 To ditto Rachel Harpers amt. Nursing intestate in death sickness per Probt. 17.83 To ditto pd. ditto part of funeral expenses per Probt. 5.40 Aug. 13(?) To ditto pd. James Sykes per Probt. 1.07 To ditto pd. Sykes & Naudain per ditto 16.07 To ditto pd. Thos. Stevenson Judge (unclear) 12.40 To fees for passing this account 2.14 To Commissions 13.10 75.70 To Balance unappropriated 55.85 CONTRA D By amt. of this Inventory 96.55 By Cash amt. from Rachel Harpers money in Intestates possession at her death 35.00 131.55 Examined adjusted passed and Settled this 13th day of August, 1811 (signed) James Harper, Register
